facts.founders_experience: GEP was founded by Subhash Makhija (CEO) and David Clevenger. Subhash Makhija has over 25 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, and enterprise software, having previously worked with global consulting firms and technology providers. The leadership team includes veterans from procurement, supply chain, and enterprise software domains, with backgrounds at companies like IBM, Accenture, and SAP.

key_leaders.name: Subhash Makhija
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CEO
key_leaders.background: Over 25 years in procurement, supply chain, and enterprise software. Former consultant with global firms.

key_leaders.name: David Clevenger
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & President
key_leaders.background: Expertise in procurement transformation and enterprise software delivery.

key_leaders.name: Dipan Karumsi
key_leaders.title: Chief Technology Officer
key_leaders.background: Technology leader with experience in AI, cloud, and enterprise platforms.

facts.deployment_scale: GEP’s platforms are deployed globally across Fortune 500 enterprises, supporting thousands of users and billions in spend under management. The company operates in over 100 countries with multi-cloud and on-premise deployment options.

use_cases: AI-driven spend analytics and cost optimization

capabilities: Supply chain visibility and risk management

required_skills: Procurement and supply chain domain expertise
facts.gap_notes: Deep domain expertise required for deployment, especially in complex enterprise environments.

training_needs: Integration with existing procurement and ERP systems

integration_requirements: ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics)
Data lakes and warehouses (Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Legacy procurement and supply chain systems
facts.complexity_notes: Highly configurable solutions requiring professional services and partner ecosystems for deployment.

facts.monetization_model: Enterprise contracts, subscription-based SaaS, and managed services

facts.gtm_model: Direct sales, partner-led (system integrators, consulting firms), and enterprise sales motion
facts.sales_motion: High-touch enterprise sales with long sales cycles

expansion_paths: Multi-million dollar contracts for enterprise deployments (typical range: $1M–$20M+ annually for large enterprises)

partner_programs: Alliances with Accenture, Deloitte, and other global system integrators

facts.contracting_notes: Pricing is typically customized based on scope, user count, and services required.

facts.fit_notes: High-touch enterprise model with long sales cycles and custom pricing.
